_: The articles: per tool page, the chunks its prose breaks into. `at` is the opening words of the sentence a chunk starts on, matched against the page's own text (a build that cannot find it fails; nothing is guessed), and a chunk boundary becomes a paragraph break. `heading` is the chunk's heading, a fact, not a promise. Read by web/lib/articles.ts; applied by lib/explorer.ts (the tool page, folded per chunk) and lib/article.ts (the article, headings only).
